primary.endpoint: Mean original-rule success fraction at g16..33 across four packets per block, then across28 fresh acquisition blocks.
primary.criterion: One paired acquisition-block contrast: current-success guard minus matched-random under independent noise. Support iff nondegenerate one-sided95% t lower>0; contradiction iff nondegenerate one-sided95% upper<=0; otherwise unresolved. No optional stopping, outcome-driven extension, substitution or equivalence claim.
primary.inference: 28 fresh acquisition blocks are the uncertainty unit. Quota coupling stays within each block. Packets, reads and arms are not independent replicates. Approximate paired t inference; new founders from the same declared acquisition/selection procedure.

allocation.rule: At each g15..32, count K current successful guard reads among the four packets in this block and noise regime. Guard promotes precisely those successful candidates. The matched-random arm promotes a uniform K-subset of its own four candidates, regardless of its own current results. Ordinary arm always promotes; protected arm never promotes. g33 outgoing candidates are not inherited.
allocation.seed: First16 SHA256 bytes, little-endian, of compact JSON [namespace,stage,block,0,generation,promotion_subset]. PCG64 permutation of [0,1,2,3], firstK. Separate channel from native forcing. Independent cue noise only.
allocation.schedule: All current reads precede the count. No future observations, donor outcomes from other blocks or later target decisions can enter the current action. Guard never depends on the matched-random arm.
allocation.apparatus: Matched-random is a coupled diagnostic comparator supplied with the guard group contemporaneous aggregate K. It has no per-packet success input, but is not a standalone feedback-free scheduler. Both own reads and the donor guard reads are retained in total computation accounting.
allocation.matching: Exactly equal rewrite counts per block, noise regime and generation; no claim of equal counts per packet or historical stratum.

secondary: Descriptive ordinary-policy, terminal, uninterrupted, opposite-rule, historical-stratum and shared pre-action g15 recovery endpoints. Cannot rescue the primary. Matched-noise performance and noise interaction are not retested.
forcing: Unchanged forcing implementation and law, with new namespace and scientific stage. Independent cue noise only. Uniform injury24 of244 non-port cells, paired across all four policy arms, own evolving packets. Teaching and acquisition retain their declared original coordinated randomness.
qualification: One seven-worker full-native wave: one exact archived acquisition replay, two disposable fresh acquisition blocks, four complete synthetic continuation units under independent noise. Independently propagate all four packets and four policies over g15..33 with the flat reader, verify quota/action/forcing chains and mixed actions. Gate measured full-cap cost before any scientific acquisition.
exposure: The allocation hypothesis and sample-size inputs are outcome-informed by the exposed21-block development study. All scientific acquisition, selection, continuation and subset namespaces are newly frozen. These28 acquisition blocks are fresh. Prospective within-programme replication, not external preregistration, independent laboratory replication or RDT-specific validation.

cohort.selection: First28 eligible acquisition blocks in ascending ID, in complete7-block waves. Original rule-balanced minimum-hash g14 selector: two current failures and two successes. Retain all attempts, rejections and surplus. Stop acquisition after the first complete wave with28 eligible blocks. No future reads before the entire cohort is sealed. No replacement after future outcomes.
